title: fix: align GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna Azure cost sheets
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Records Azure East US GlobalStandard costs effective 2026-08-01: Terra $2/$0.20/$2.50/$12 and Luna $0.20/$0.02/$0.25/$1.20 per million short-context input/cache-read/cache-write/output tokens, with the corresponding >272K tiers.
- Sets Terra multiplier to `0.625` and Luna to `1`, preserving every existing customer price and Quest-Pollen access.
- Keeps canonical IDs, aliases, Azure deployments, capabilities, and no-fallback behavior unchanged.
- Direct Azure probes served `gpt-5.6-terra-2026-07-09` and `gpt-5.6-luna-2026-07-09`; 343 focused pricing/alias tests, Enter typecheck, and CI pass.
- Authenticated local Gen E2E passed for both models: short and >272K billing, canonical IDs and aliases, image input, streaming, `/v1/models`, output-cache hit, single debit, and Tinybird provider/cost/price fields. Terra billed exact Azure cost × 0.625; Luna billed exact Azure cost × 1.

Azure returned deterministic cache-write usage in live probes. Repeated long-prefix requests did not produce a provider cache-read hit, including with a stable `prompt_cache_key`; that published cache-read rate is therefore source-verified and covered by pricing tests, not live-usage-observed in this run.

Pricing evidence: [Microsoft announcement](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/gpt-5-6-now-available-in-microsoft-foundry/) · [Azure Retail Prices API](https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices)

gist.headline: The cost ledger blooms
gist.blurb: Terra and Luna's Azure accounting got a careful garden-path realignment. The prices people see and Quest-Pollen access stay exactly where they were.
gist.summary: Aligned GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna Azure East US GlobalStandard cost sheets for short and >272K-token contexts, setting Terra's cost multiplier to 0.625 and Luna's to 1 while retaining all existing customer prices, aliases, deployments, and access.
gist.impact: Billing telemetry and provider-cost records now match Azure's published Terra and Luna rates, with no change to customer-facing prices or Quest-Pollen availability.
